decisions.reason: The same-message INTRODUCE already records SIWE dashboard access through the Transak-created wallet, so no additional MODIFY is needed.
Email-link dashboard authentication remains valid and unchanged; SIWE through the provisioned wallet is an alternative path owned by the wallet-authentication Requirement.
Adding SIWE dashboard access for Transak-created wallets does not change the unauthenticated status or covered data of public APIs.
The existing same-message MODIFY already states that fiat buyers may access the dashboard through the email link or SIWE using the Transak-created wallet.
The ebook viewer behavior is established by a separate clause of the source message and is not changed by the wallet-authentication decision.
The wallet-authentication change does not alter the certificate email's contents, reading button, or download link.
Dashboard access through SIWE does not change the Brevo provider or transactional email transport behavior.
Winner notification channels are specified independently and are already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
SIWE access for a Transak-created wallet does not change automatic direct-wallet prize delivery, which is already represented by separate same-message Events.
The commission remains an immediate automatic payment to the recipient wallet; the added dashboard sign-in path does not alter that mechanism.
Wallet-based dashboard authentication does not change the badge catalog, icons, or presentation rules.
The wallet-authentication extension does not affect publication of prize-pool values through unauthenticated public APIs.
